full_prompt_en: The image is a square oil landscape of a broad encampment beneath a towering bank of summer clouds. The sky takes up nearly three quarters of the frame. Against deep teal blue, a huge cream-colored cumulus mass rises from a dark blue-gray cloud base, its rounded lobes catching warm light and its inner folds holding soft brown and violet-gray shadow. Smaller billows spread to both sides, creating an immense, heavy canopy over a narrow green horizon. Below the clouds, a thin pale horizontal band separates the distant plain from the nearer camp. The foreground ground slopes gently into a wide grassy settlement dotted with conical pale tents. Several larger tents stand toward the right and lower left, while smaller ones retreat toward the horizon. Tiny people, horses, and dark clustered forms appear between the tents; thin smoke rises from a few low points. A light earth-colored path opens near the lower center and winds through the camp. Dark shrubs and trees anchor the lower corners and edges, leaving the middle comparatively open. The viewpoint looks down slightly from outside the camp, letting the tents read as scattered small shapes under the enormous sky. Sunlight strikes the cloud crowns and selected tent faces, while the camp and lower cloud bank stay in cooler shadow. The painted surface is finely blended in the luminous cloud volumes and more concise in the minute ground detail, with warm cream, muted ochre, olive green, and deep blue-green arranged in broad horizontal layers. The composition gives most visual weight to the rolling cloud tower, while the small settled forms below supply scale and an expansive sense of distance.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形油画风景：一片开阔营地位于高耸的夏日云团之下。天空占据画幅近四分之三。深青蓝色中，一座巨大的奶油色积云从蓝灰暗云底升起，圆鼓鼓的云瓣接住暖光，内部褶皱留着柔和棕影和紫灰影。较小的云团向两侧铺开，在窄窄的绿色地平线上形成庞大而厚重的天幕。云下，一条浅色细横带把远方平原与较近营地隔开。前景地面轻轻倾入宽阔草地聚落，散布着浅色圆锥帐篷。几座较大的帐篷立在右侧与左下方，较小的逐渐退到地平线。帐篷之间出现细小的人、马和深色聚团形状；几处低点升起细烟。下方中央附近一条浅土色小路敞开，弯入营地。深色灌木和树木压住下方角落及边缘，让中间较为开放。视点从营地外略向下看，帐篷在浩大天空下读作散落的小形状。日光照到云顶和部分帐篷的迎光面，营地与下层云带则留在更冷的阴影里。发光云体用细致融合的油彩塑形，极小的地面细节则用简练点笔处理；暖奶油色、低饱和赭色、橄榄绿与深蓝绿排成宽阔横层。构图把多数视觉重量交给翻卷的云塔，下面小小的定居形体提供尺度与开阔的远近感。
style_prompt_en: Oil-paint modeling joins finely blended luminous volumes with concise small dark marks across a distant low plane. A vast upper field is built from rounded cream and warm gray masses, their internal folds shifting gradually into blue-gray shadow. Deep teal surrounds the lighter forms, while olive, ochre, and brown settle into a narrow textured band below. The horizon remains low and nearly level, making vertical expansion above it the dominant rhythm. Light catches high rounded surfaces and selected small pale accents; the lower band stays comparatively subdued. Near details are abbreviated and clustered, while distance softens through horizontal layers and slight atmospheric haze. The surface is calm and detailed without hard graphic outlines, balancing broad sculpted forms against many small scattered marks.
style_prompt_zh: 油画塑形把细致融合的明亮体积与远处低平面上的简练暗色小记号结合。辽阔上部由圆鼓的奶油色和暖灰色块搭起，内部褶皱逐渐转入蓝灰阴影。深青色围住亮块，橄榄、赭和棕色落成下方一道狭窄有纹理的色带。地平线保持低而近乎水平，使上方的纵向扩张成为主导节奏。光落在圆鼓高处和选定的细小浅色点上；下部色带相对收敛。近处细节简化而成群，远处则通过横向层次与轻微空气薄雾变柔。表面安静而细致，没有坚硬的图形勾线，让宽大的雕塑感形体与许多散落的小痕迹保持平衡。
theme_en: A broad encampment beneath a towering bank of summer clouds
theme_zh: 高耸夏云下的一片开阔营地
name: George Catlin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
